final: WITH funding_counts AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS funding_source, COUNT(DISTINCT s.arcref) AS project_count FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), totals AS (SELECT SUM(project_count) AS total_count FROM funding_counts), shares AS (SELECT f.funding_source, f.project_count, CAST(f.project_count AS REAL) / t.total_count AS project_share FROM funding_counts AS f CROSS JOIN totals AS t WHERE t.total_count IS NOT NULL), averages AS (SELECT AVG(project_count) AS average_count FROM shares) SELECT s.funding_source, s.project_count, s.project_share, s.project_count - a.average_count AS difference_from_average FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN averages AS a WHERE a.average_count IS NOT NULL AND s.project_count > a.average_count
